description: Use this when the user says an unusual response or run time was expected (a deploy, a sale, a migration). Returns the anomaly's new state. A dismissed anomaly no longer counts and is left out of future baselines; dismissed false restores it. Not for turning anomaly detection off: use set_anomaly_detection.

dismissed.description: False to restore a dismissed anomaly; true by default.

event.description: The anomaly's event number, from set_anomaly_detection or get_site.

note.description: Why it was expected, up to 200 characters.

site.description: The site, by id, name or part of its URL.

name: dismiss_anomaly
title: Mark an anomaly as expected
